topic.label: Investing and Portfolio Management
topic.desc: Building and running portfolios: asset allocation, funds and ETFs, risk and return, performance tracking, and quantitative strategies and backtesting.

concepts.label: Asset Allocation
concepts.desc: Mixing stocks, bonds, cash and alternatives for a goal, horizon and risk tolerance, and rebalancing.

concepts.label: Funds and ETFs
concepts.desc: Mutual funds, ETFs, index funds, expense ratios, tracking error and fund structures.

concepts.label: Quantitative Strategies and Backtesting
concepts.desc: Systematic strategies, factor models, backtesting and overfitting.

concepts.label: Risk and Return
concepts.desc: Volatility, drawdown, correlation, beta, Sharpe ratio, value at risk and factor exposure.

concepts.label: Performance Tracking
concepts.desc: Tracking holdings and performance: time-weighted and money-weighted returns, benchmarks and attribution.

skills.label: Allocation Planner
skills.desc: Proposes an asset allocation for a goal and horizon and explains its risk.

skills.label: Rebalancing Planner
skills.desc: Plans rebalancing back to target weights with tax and cost notes.

skills.label: Fund Comparator
skills.desc: Compares funds by holdings, fees, tracking error and structure.

skills.label: Backtest Reviewer
skills.desc: Reviews a backtest for look-ahead bias, survivorship bias, costs and overfitting.

skills.label: Portfolio Risk Report
skills.desc: Reports a portfolio's volatility, drawdown, beta, VaR and concentration.

skills.label: Performance Attribution
skills.desc: Attributes a portfolio's return to allocation and selection versus its benchmark.

skills.label: Position Tracker
skills.desc: Tracks positions, cost basis and unrealized gains for a portfolio.

mcp.name: QuantConnect MCP
mcp.desc: QuantConnect MCP server: algorithmic trading research, backtests, projects and quantitative strategy code on the LEAN engine.

mcp.name: Yahoo Finance MCP
mcp.desc: Yahoo Finance MCP server: stock prices, historical quotes, company financial statements, holders, options chains and news.
